label: Tiamat system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Tiamat locus represented by a TmtA profile that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Tiamat branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual TmtA genes, TmtA proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Tiamat locus, unresolved Tiamat trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
